_README: NECROMANCER PASS #1 (Coeus). Archaeology only: nothing was resurrected, no historical agent was run as an agent. Coeus's own loaders/encoders were executed as INSTRUMENTS (apparatus control, LAW N14) to test its shipped artifacts against the forge ledger on disk. All numbers below are reproducible from dossiers/coeus_evidence/. This dossier OVERTURNS both prior verdicts: the Aug-2026 autopsy null (NO-DESIGN-FAILURE) rested on a vacuous observable, and the Jun-2026 RETIRE rested on an untested 'decorative-causal' assertion that turns out to be true but for a different reason than stated.

original_organism.premise: Which concept triples forge successfully is CAUSED by identifiable concept-level properties; learning those properties from the forge ledger and feeding them back as priority scores will raise forge yield.
original_organism.mechanism: Encode each Nous concept triple as 122 concept indicators + 20 field indicators + 4 Nous sub-scores; join to the Hephaestus forge ledger (status forged/scrap); fit per-concept 'forge_effect' and pair 'synergy' (NOTEARS/DAGMA intended; shipped artifact is the Lasso(alpha=0.01) fallback, graph.method='lasso_regression'); publish concept_scores.json; Hephaestus adds sum(forge_effect)+sum(pair_synergy) to the Nous composite when sorting the forge queue.

autopsy.kill_boundary: What the evidence KILLS: (1) 'Coeus's shipped concept scores carry forge-outcome signal that transfers across forge configurations.' Leave-one-forge-day-out, api-failures excluded: concept indicators trained on all other days score AUC 0.461 on 2026-03-26 (738 rows/173 forged) and 0.338 on 03-27 (568/60), at or below the label-permutation null; the shipped forge_boost scores AUC 0.487 on the 1605 post-build rows (perm p=0.55, but that window is itself instrument-dead: 2553 api_call_failed). (2) 'Concept identity predicts forge outcome even under a FIXED judge.' Within-single-forge-day 5-fold CV on the largest day (03-26): concepts AUC 0.501 vs null mean 0.493, nothing; the two smaller days give 0.62/0.64 vs null-max 0.57/0.61 (20 draws), not separable. (3) The autopsy's observable: 1e-3 Gaussian noise on the composite changes 99.7% of queue positions (min over 200 draws 99.5%); Coeus changes 99.9%. 'Positions change' is vacuous and cannot support a null verdict. NOT killed: the mechanism runs; the consumer is wired; the weaker proposition 'some concept-level structure exists under a frozen judge with a healthy API' is untested at adequate power because no such clean window exists in the data. WHAT THE POOLED SIGNAL WAS: stratified 5-fold CV over all pre-build rows gives concepts AUC 0.707-0.723 and +0.05..+0.07 over the Nous composite (null max 0.53). This survived api-failure exclusion (0.702) and leave-one-Nous-run-out per-fold (0.64-0.71 on the 3 large runs) but died under leave-one-forge-DAY-out; the run x forge-day crosstab shows every Nous run was forged across 3+ days, so run-holdout still shares forge days with training. The 'signal' Coeus learned is the forge CALENDAR: day base rates 58%->23%->10%->2.5%, driven by trap-battery version (15-trap -> 58-category on 03-27) and API health, fingerprinted through which concept batches were forged when. The Nous composite itself is ~0.53 within-day. The design failure is therefore in MEASUREMENT: Coeus regressed a label that mostly records instrument state (api_call_failed and judge version are recorded as 'scrap' alongside genuine trap failures) and never filtered, stratified, or held out by forge time; then labelled the regression 'causal'/'interventional' (0 confounders, [] DAGMA divergences, method=lasso_regression) and shipped 1009 pair synergies fit on 352 positives (in-sample AUC 0.887, never validated) into a live priority function whose effect on yield was never measured.
surviving_claims: The Coeus apparatus (loaders, encoder, regression) executes today and is reusable as an instrument.
The consumer seam (hephaestus._forge_priority) is real and executes. The P47/P50 autopsy was right about wiring, wrong about what wiring proves.
The June 'decorative-causal' assertion is factually correct (Lasso fallback labelled causal), but it is a claim/method mismatch, not evidence that no signal exists.

Untested, not killed: under a FROZEN judge configuration with a healthy API, concept-level structure in forge outcome may exist; no window in the historical data is clean enough (>=500 rows, >=50 forged, one battery version, no api failures) to decide at power.
uncertainty: Within-day nulls on 03-25 (255 rows) and 03-27 (568 rows/60 forged) are marginal (0.62/0.64 vs null-max 0.57/0.61 from only 20 permutations); a 500-draw null would sharpen but cannot rescue the transfer kill.
Forge-day is a proxy for judge-version + API-health; the two were not separated (both change on 03-27).
The 'regime' split uses Nous timestamps for the shipped-scores OOS test and ledger timestamps for the forge-day attack; the crosstab shows why both are needed.
LAW N13: the kill was produced and attacked only by this investigator; an independent re-run of coeus_evidence/coeus_attacks.py by another lens is owed before this dossier is cited as settled.
contradictory_evidence: P50 Elenchus execution result (10,094/10,105 positions change): reproduced here (99.9%) and shown vacuous by the reorder-null (measurement carries its answer).
Stratified-CV in-sample positive (AUC 0.72, +0.05 over composite): real number, wrong reading; explained by forge-calendar leakage.

disposition.rationale: Chosen over NO_DESIGN_FAILURE_ESTABLISHED because two design failures ARE now established: (a) Coeus regressed an outcome dominated by instrument state (API failures + judge-version base-rate shifts recorded as 'scrap') without time-based holdout or filtering, so what it learned and shipped is the forge calendar, not concept causality, shown by the leave-one-forge-day-out kill (0.461/0.338) and the within-day null on the largest day (0.501); (b) it labelled a Lasso fallback 'causal/interventional' and shipped 1009 unvalidated pair synergies into a live priority function whose effect was never measured. Chosen over TRUE_CORPSE because the premise ('concept-level structure in forge outcome') is untested-at-power under a clean judge, not falsified; no clean window exists in the historical data; TRUE_CORPSE is the leading neighbour if the descendant test returns null. Not PREMISE_ALIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_DEAD (implementation executes; premise is not shown alive). Not CONSUMER_BLOCKED (consumer executes; its EFFECT is unmeasured, which is measurement). Not RESOURCE_BLOCKED, although the post-03-27 API death is a RESOURCE event: it killed the outcome variable of the seam, and belongs in Hephaestus's dossier.
